Triveni Turbine Limited to host Q1 FY27 Results Conference Call on 
Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 12:30 PM IST  
 
Triveni Turbine Limited, a leading steam turbine OEM with end-to-end capabilities for steam 
turbines up to 100 MW and manufacturing, refurbishment, retrofit, and lifecycle solutions for 
steam turbines up to 1,000 MW across leading global OEM platforms, will organize its Q1 FY27 
results conference call for analysts & investors on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 at 12:30 PM IST.  
Senior members of the management team of the Company will be present on the call.  
In order to login instantly, Investors are advised to pre-register for the call via:  
https://services.choruscall.in/DiamondPassRegistration/register?confirmationNumber=6695636&linkS
ecurityString=39b18f5740  
 
(Copy and paste link in the browser) 
Details of the conference call are as follows: 
 
Timing 
12:30 PM IST on Tuesday, August 11, 2026 
Conference dial-in 
 
Primary number 
+91 22 6280 1141 / +91 22 7115 8042 
Singapore Toll Free Number 
800 101 2045 
Hong Kong Toll Free Number 
800 964 448 
USA Toll Free Number 
1 866 746 2133 
UK Toll Free Number 
0 808 101 1573 
 
Participants are requested to dial-in 10 minutes in advance.
